belief: My vote, my voice, and my life don't matter.
origins: Feeling unheard by officials, lost in large systems, or outvoted again and again can make participation seem pointless. Some also grew up in settings where speaking up was punished. We shrink and stay quiet.
teaches: God told Jeremiah, “Seek the prosperity of the city… for if it prospers, you too will prosper.” Jesus said, “Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.” Mordecai asked Esther whether she had come to the kingdom for such a time as this. Proverbs says, “He who answers a matter before he hears it…” and urges honest speech: “speak truthfully to his neighbor.” In God’s eyes, every person matters. How and whether we engage civic life is for each of us to decide prayerfully, but we are not nobodies.
self_statements: No one listens to people like me.
errors: Believing my voice has total or no effect.
Feeling powerless and concluding that I am.
Predicting that nothing I do matters.
questions: Where have I felt unheard, and who was involved?
What small things have I influenced?
What does God say about my value?
Where do I have the most influence: home, church, work, neighborhood?
What does faithful citizenship look like for me?
What is one step I can take?
truth: I matter to God, and my life has influence in places I may overlook. I can pray, vote, speak, and serve as I am able, without carrying the weight of the whole nation.
hw_truths: God knows me and values me.
I am worth more than many sparrows.
I can seek the good of my city.
I do not carry the nation.
log: Each week, note one small way you contributed.
actions: Vote, volunteer, or write a note.
Pray by name for places and people.
prayer: Father, I feel small and unheard. Thank You for counting me valuable. Show me where I can serve, speak, and pray, and give me peace about the rest. Amen.
name_example: Sarah can write: “I am worth more than many sparrows, so my life matters.”
meta: Christian belief counseling for “My vote, my voice, and my life don't matter.” with BSB scriptures, questions, songs, and practical homework.
